trap.label: because
trap.wrong: One reason is because bias flashcards help.
trap.right: One reason is that bias flashcards help.
trap.why: Em português “um motivo é porque” é comum. Em inglês, depois de reason is use that.

opts: One reason is because it helps.
One reason it is that helps.
One reason is that it helps.

fix.wrong: In my opinion, loss aversion are real.
fix.right: In my opinion, loss aversion is real.

fix.wrong: Another reason is the sunk cost, for example, people buy more.
fix.right: Another reason is sunk cost. For example, people buy more.

rewrite.prompt: Reescreva com One reason is: “Flashcards help because they are short.”
rewrite.answer: One reason is that flashcards are short.

rewrite.prompt: Reescreva com Admittedly: “Framing is subtle, but it matters.” (Admittedly,…)
rewrite.answer: Admittedly, framing is subtle, but it matters.

rewrite.prompt: Reescreva com I’d say that: “I think sunk cost matters.”
rewrite.answer: I’d say that sunk cost matters.
